notes: Item 19 discloses Average Annual Gross Sales and Average Gross Profit Margin for 186 SYNERGY HomeCare Businesses (523 Units) open 1+ year as of December 31, 2025, for the 2025 calendar year. Data is split into Multi-Unit Franchise Businesses (141 total) and Single-Unit Franchise Businesses (45 total), each further broken down by tenure bands. Gross Profit Margin is defined as revenues less caregiver wages (excluding payroll taxes and workers' comp) divided by revenues. The cohort_name 'ownership_group_anchored' was used throughout since the primary split is by single-unit vs. multi-unit ownership type. The tenure sub-bands are preserved in cohort_raw. Gross profit margin values are stored as percentages (e.g., 49 = 49%). Note that for the 6-to-9 year single-unit cohort, the average ($965,392) is lower than the median ($1,198,610), which is unusual but faithfully reflects the source document — likely due to the small sample size (n=5).
